team.member.import.brief: Add people to the console from a list
team.member.import.description: Paste a list of people — name and email in any shape, or the ids of uploaded files — and everyone in it gets an account, the chosen role, a staff card and a sign-in link. Running the same list twice adds nobody twice. Roles: manager, operator, viewer. Answers with the table of exactly these people.
